in_sanskrit.name: कामिका
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: She who fulfills desire or passion. The name Kamika is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Kama', which means desire or passion. In Hindu mythology, Kamadeva, the god of desire, is often depicted carrying a bow made of sugarcane and flowers. He is also known as the 'god of love'. Kamika is a name that evokes the sensual and passionate nature of love.
